title: insight: A Unified Interface to Access Information from Model Objects in R
journal: The Journal of Open Source Software
authors: Lüdecke, D., Waggoner, P., & Makowski, D.
summary: insight is the package the rest of easystats stands on: one interface for getting information out of a fitted model — its predictors, random effects, priors, formula — whatever package produced it. It exists because every model class in R exposes its internals differently.
